verdict.rationale: LegalZoom offers customizable legal documents and document storage, so e-signature bulk sending is a fair question for this kind of legal-services platform. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents sending a document to many recipients at once, or any e-signature workflow at all. Customizable documents and cloud storage are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can bulk-send the same document to many recipients at once
